request.subject: EFFECT:STARFALL_BURST

layers.text: Change only two things: erase the round stand and its stem under the starburst completely, leaving that area transparent; and recolour the dark brown rays bright green #00ff78, so cream and green rays alternate round the pale flash. Do not redraw anything else: keep the round flash, the cream rays and the sparks, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
